_meta.googleAntigravityStaging: google-antigravity staging: the Antigravity Go harness owns the conversation history and never sends role:"tool" messages -- a completed tool call comes back as an assistant message whose text is 'Tool response for <name>: ...'. hasToolResult/toolCallId therefore never fire here, so each leg is staged on turnIndex (assistant-message count; +2 per tool round-trip, +1 per text answer).
